sections.content: You know the present perfect (*ha cambiado*) from A2 Unit 1 and the imperfect (*había*) from A2 Unit 21; B1 Unit 5 contrasted them for change over time. Here you use them for the environment: the present perfect for a change that matters now, and *antes … ahora* to contrast the earlier and the present situation, with *en los últimos años* for the recent period.

items.spanish: El río ha cambiado mucho en los últimos años.
items.english: The river has changed a lot in recent years.

items.spanish: La contaminación ha aumentado en la ciudad.
items.english: Pollution has increased in the city.

items.spanish: La cantidad de agua ha disminuido.
items.english: The amount of water has decreased.

items.spanish: Antes había más árboles, pero ahora hay menos.
items.english: There used to be more trees, but now there are fewer.

sections.content: With *haber* the participle never changes: *Las especies han desaparecido*, not *han desaparecidas*.
